from pathlib import Path
prog='''def transform(grid):
    # The uniform marker row/column separates two binary patterns.
    sep_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0,)]
    if sep_rows:
        i = sep_rows[0]
        a, b = grid[:i], grid[i+1:]
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    # Side-by-side form, separated by a uniform marker column.
    sep_cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] == grid[0][j] for row in grid) and len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1 and grid[0][j] not in (0,)]
    j = sep_cols[0]
    return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(row[:j], row[j+1:])] for row in grid]
'''
